incentive_structure: monthly service charge + contract demand $/kW + as-used daily demand charges with a 3-period time-of-use structure
event_limits: Effective January 1 2026; replaces the former SC 12 Back-Up and Supplemental Service and closed Rate Code 681. Commercial standby is Rate Code 682 with eleven sub-rate codes; optional residential standby rates are also offered. Mandatory for about 72 existing commercial customers, optional for most others (SC-5, SC-7, SC-10, SC-13, unmetered and non-AMI customers may not opt in). Existing mandatory customers default to a five-year phase-in running Jan 1 2026 through Dec 31 2030, with full standby rates for everyone on Jan 1 2031; new customers taking service after the amendment date pay full standby rates with no phase-in. Optional Rate Customers must have an AMI meter and, if they switch back to a flat non-time-varying rate, cannot return to standby or another time-varying rate for at least one year. Standby customers qualifying for Rate 285-Primary or Rate 285-Transmission who take Authority supply are billed supply hourly at LBMP plus capacity based on their individual capacity tag. Peak-to-off-peak as-used daily demand ratio is 1.25:1, producing a summer-to-winter demand rate ratio of 2.25; the Super Off-Peak period incurs no as-used daily demand charge
